events.title: Meow Cards is joining the October Steam Next Fest — free demo available now!
events.summary: Hello everyone!Our feline-starring game Meow Cards is taking part in Steam Next Fest! Since the demo launched, we've been continuously polishing the game and have updated a whole new set of art assets. Whether you've played before or haven't had the chance yet — you're all warmly invited to give it a try!If you like the game, don't forget to add it to your Steam Wishlist! events.summary: Update LogUI & Typography: Complete UI layout overhaul with optimized fonts.Animations: Now display HandScore Proficiency Levels first, followed by Bonus Card settlements.Card Library: Adjusted text and sound effects (SFX).Shop: Added an audio alert for insufficient gold.

events.title: MeowCards v1.9 Update
events.summary: Update Highlights:Visuals: Spruced up the UI for the Newbie Tutorial.Bug Fix: The Back button is now hidden on the Level 2 screen to prevent glitches caused by going back. New Feature: Added a CardLibrary to the level interface.Balance Change: Deleting cards in the Shop now costs 35 Meow Coins.
